pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with softened, rounded vertices. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients. Patch size is maximal on the upper flank and neck, becoming progressively smaller and more irregular/ovoid towards the rump and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, interconnected web of light cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness is consistent across the mid-flank, with slight widening at nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short-cropped mane exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background. Individual follicles are not resolvable, resulting in a fuzzy 1D geometric contour.
